content: We call the proposed architecture Cell-aware Stacked LSTM, or CAS-LSTM, and evaluate our method on multiple benchmark datasets: SNLI BIBREF22 , MultiNLI BIBREF23 , Quora Question Pairs BIBREF24 , and SST BIBREF25 . From experiments we show that the CAS-LSTMs consistently outperform typical stacked LSTMs, opening the possibility of performance improvement of architectures that use stacked LSTMs.
